scope.flow: L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager using block.timestamp as deadline
scope.environment: Solidity smart contract on L2 using Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager

statements.text: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange passes block.timestamp as the deadline argument to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager, so the deadline check compares block.timestamp against the same value and is a no-op.
A transaction with insufficient gas may not be mined immediately and remains pending.
Pending transactions without a proper deadline can be executed maliciously at a later time.
Malicious actors or MEV bots could execute these delayed transactions at a disadvantage to the original submitter.
The deadline argument passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager should enforce a real expiry so a transaction cannot be executed after its intended deadline.

ambiguities: No concrete transaction, actor, or observed execution is reported; the delayed-execution harm is stated only as a possibility.
The report does not state who submits the delayed transaction or whether the original submitter is identifiable.
No specific amount, asset value, or quantitative loss is given.
